eas_text: A civil authority has issued A REQUIRED WEEKLY TEST for the following counties or areas: Columbia; Luzerne, PA; at 8:00 AM on AUG 19, 2021 Effective until 10:00 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: THIS IS A TEST  This is the Susquehanna Nuclear Annual Siren Test  THIS IS ONLY A TEST.  The Susquehanna Steam Electric Station is presently conducting a coordinated two-county siren test.  The sirens that you are hearing are part of a coordinated two-county test of the Susquehanna Steam Electric Station Siren Warning System.  This is only a test.  This has been the Pennsylvania Emergency Management Agency.
